Stephen Curry keeps making HISTORY! Curry dropped 31 points, dished out 6 assists and knocked down 8 three-pointers. At 38 years and 230 days old, he joins LeBron James, who has done it three times, as the only players aged 38 or older to record at least 30 points, 5 assists and 8 made threes in a game. Watch the highlights from another milestone performance!
